headline: Dismissed an ethics complaint as moot after the individual it concerned resigned.
summary: Marco Palmieri said he was not formally invited to the hearing. Members asked him questions about his complaint. The complaint was dismissed as moot because the individual it concerned resigned.
decisions: Approved dismissal of the ethics complaint as moot, all in favor.

decision_titles: Ethics complaint against an individual who resigned
plain_text:
Ethics Board Committee      
 
 
 
 
City of Bristol 
BRISTOL, CONNECTICUT  06010 
 
ETHICS COMMITTEE 
SPECIAL MEETING 
MINUTES  
WEDNESDAY SEPTEMBER 30, 2026 
6:00 P.M. 
 
1. CALL TO ORDER:  The meeting was called to order at 6:05pm 
  
By:  Chairman Roger Chiasson    Time: 6:05 pm  Place:    City Hall  
           111 North Main Street 
           Meeting Room 1-2 
 
 NAME PRESENT ABSENT 
MEMBERS Roger Chiasson, Chairman X  
 Bruce Barton X  
 Byron Pierce  X 
 Joan Cloutier  X 
 John Bellemare X  
 Kristen O’Donnell (zoom) X  
 Eric Carlson X  
    
STAFF Maria Theam, Recording Secretary  X  
 
The following were also in attendance: Marco Palmeri 
 
2. Review Ethics Complaint and Take Any Necessary Action  
 
Marco Palmieri stated that he was not formally invited to the hearing this evening.  Chairman Roger Chiasson explained 
what the options were for tonight.  Marco expressed he would like a final decision eventually made.  Discussion was had 
about Dr. Palmeri’s complaint and the Ethics members asked questions of Dr. Palmeri.   
 
MOTION: To go into Executive Session at John Bellemare at 6:21 pm 
 
BY:  John Bellemare     Seconded: Eric Carlson 
 
For:   All in favor 
Against: None 
Abstained: None
Ethics Board Committee      
 
 
MOTION: To exit executive session and return to the special meeting at 6:36pm 
 
BY: Bruce Barton     Seconded: John Bellemare 
 
For:   All in favor 
Against: None 
Abstained: None 
 
Chairman Chiasson stated the complaint is moot based on the ethics guidelines.  Dr. Palmeri could seek remedy 
elsewhere.  Dr. Palmeri asked the board to reconsider their opinion on the matter.   
 
MOTION:  to dismiss the complaint as moot due to the resignation of the individual who is the subject of the 
complaint. 
 
BY:  John Bellemare    Seconded: Eric Carlson 
 
For:   All in favor 
Against: None 
Abstained: None 
 
3. ADJOURNMENT 
MOTION: To adjourn at 6:50pm 
 
 
BY:          Roger Chiasson                                                  Seconded: Eric Carlson  
  
For:   All in favor 
Against: None 
Abstained: None 
 
 
Respectfully submitted, 
 
Maria Theam, recording secretary
